faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Bodh Gaya Management Trainee cum Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor position at IIM Bodh Gaya is 27 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Clinical/Counselling Psychology from a recognized Institute/University with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this IIM Bodh Gaya recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years as of the cut-off date. Age relaxation will be provided as per Central Government rules for eligible categories like SC/ST/NC-OBC/PWD/Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor role will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIM Bodh Gaya Management Trainee cum Counsellor vacancy?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Bodh Gaya. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and potentially paying a fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor position at IIM Bodh Gaya includes a Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IIM Bodh Gaya recruitment?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, no application fee is mentioned for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor – Clinical/ Counselling Psychology recruitment. Candidates should verify this in the detailed PDF.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The Management Trainee cum Counsellor position at IIM Bodh Gaya is a Contractual job type. This means the employment will be for a specified period, as outlined in the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor position is Bodh Gaya, Bihar. Candidates selected for the role will be required to work at the Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya campus.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for IIM Bodh Gaya?
faq.answer: The official website for the Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya is www.iimbg.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more details, to apply online, and to access the official notification.
